| # Object 0x1010 store parameters for non-volatile storage {#object-0x1010-store-parameters-for-non-volatile-storage-1 .p_Heading1 style="page-break-after: avoid;"}                                                                                                                                              |                                                                                                                                                                        |
+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+

This object entry supports saving of parameters in non volatile memory.

 

  Index       0x1010
  ----------- -------------------------------------------
  Name        Store Parameters for non volatile storage
  Object      ARRAY
  Data Type   UNSIGNED 32
  Category    Optional

 

 

SubIndex Supported

  SubIndex        0
  --------------- ----------------------------
  Description     Largest subIndex supported
  Access          RO
  Value Range     0x1-0x7F
  Default Value   0x4

 

 

  SubIndex        1
  --------------- ---------------------
  Description     Save all parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   No

 

  SubIndex        2
  --------------- -------------------------------
  Description     Save communication parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

  SubIndex        3
  --------------- -----------------------------
  Description     Save application parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0

 

  SubIndex        4
  --------------- --------------------------------------
  Description     Save manufacturer defined parameters
  Access          RW
  Value Range     UNSIGNED 32
  Default Value   0
